cases.title: is a node24 JavaScript action with an always-run post step
cases.reason: Actions interprets this shipped metadata: the entrypoint and unconditional post lifecycle determine whether owned leases are released on failure/cancel.

cases.title: declares the inputs the wave-chain callers depend on
cases.reason: The external action input contract supplies run identity and default release behavior to independent workflow callers.

cases.title: stays self-contained so it can be duplicated into the public repo
cases.reason: Shallow regex import and directory inventories do not establish runnable artifact independence; dynamic imports and runtime resolution escape the scan.

cases.title: never reaches for the GCE metadata server
cases.reason: Scanning for one host literal does not establish the authentication path; actual token-source behavior is covered by the separately reviewed storage suite.

rationale: Retain Actions lifecycle/input metadata while removing shallow import/host source scans.

cases.title: docs package has an isolated, reproducible app contract
cases.reason: Copied manifest, dependency and pinned version inventory is already exercised by frozen dependency installation and the real docs build.

cases.title: all customer-facing docs pages and navigation metadata are present
cases.reason: Retain nonempty content/navigation discovery and per-file metadata validation; remove minimum counts and copied page inventory that reject intentional content changes.

cases.title: every local media URL referenced by docs resolves in public assets
cases.reason: Discover actual referenced media from current docs and check the published asset tree, catching broken customer URLs independently of a copied list.

cases.title: docs content does not link to routes that only exist on the marketing site
cases.reason: Retain deployment-boundary link checks and require nonempty discovery so missing content cannot pass vacuously.

cases.title: published docs do not retain private source provenance
cases.reason: Historical provenance strings are a small source blacklist rather than a general publication boundary; arbitrary renamed material passes.

cases.title: reviewed private demo media stays outside the publication boundary
cases.reason: Three copied historical filenames do not establish whether current published assets are private; intentional content changes otherwise need test edits.

cases.title: docs routes stay namespaced and the generated source uses /docs as its base URL
cases.reason: Large source-regex and file inventories mix routing, styling and layout implementation; actual namespaced behavior belongs to the built app verification.

cases.title: GIF media helpers use the shared poster and video variants
cases.reason: Retain helper output and real referenced asset checks; remove unrelated whats-new directory absence inventory.

cases.title: versioning seam keeps current docs stable without claiming live versioned routes
cases.reason: Checks future scaffold literals and README phrasing instead of calling the version path function or resolving deployed routes.

cases.title: OG image fonts ship with their required third-party notice
cases.reason: Retain required binary font and license publication assets; remove source-style regex unrelated to font availability.

cases.title: docs app has no marketing-only route or analytics dependency
cases.reason: Scanning source imports and two directory names is an incomplete dependency/route blacklist rather than observed behavior.

rationale: Retain discovered content, deployment links, media helper outputs and font/license assets; trim copied manifest/page/source/style inventories and add nonempty discovery guards.

cases.title: unterminated escaped link destinations do not backtrack exponentially
cases.reason: The real formatter runs on long malformed link destinations under a VM deadline, with independent expected text.

cases.title: link destinations retain escaped closing parentheses and literal escapes
cases.reason: Input/output tables protect distinct escaping and destination-parsing cases.

cases.title: search excerpts omit inline Markdown syntax
cases.reason: Observed formatter output protects customer excerpt rendering for common Markdown syntax.

cases.title: search excerpts preserve highlighted matches inside Markdown
cases.reason: Actual mixed code/highlight/link outputs protect token preservation and nested stripping order.

cases.title: unclosed angles avoid the HTML matcher without changing excerpt text
cases.reason: Replace global replace monkeypatch and exact regex-source spy with bounded execution of a long unclosed-angle input; disabling the production guard must time out.

cases.title: tag guards preserve malformed markup, protected code and highlighted matches
cases.reason: Distinct malformed markup, code, highlight and link tables specify actual output independently.

cases.title: unclosed brackets avoid link matchers without changing excerpt text
cases.reason: Replace internal regex spy with bounded actual formatter execution on long unclosed brackets; disabling the production guard must time out.

rationale: Replace implementation spies with bounded actual formatter execution.
